question: "Playing It My Way" is an autobiography of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sachin Tendulkar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Playing It My Way" **is an** autobiography** written by **Sachin Tendulkar**, one of the greatest cricketers of all time.
 
• The book was published in **2014 **and covers Tendulkar's life and career, from his childhood in Mumbai to his retirement from** international cricket in 2013.**
 
• Tendulkar is widely regarded as one of the **greatest batsmen in the history of cricket,** having scored more runs and centuries than any other player in both** Test and ODI formats.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MS Dhoni** is also a famous Indian cricketer who captained the** Indian national team** from** 2007 to 2016.**

 
 
• He has also written an autobiography called **"The Dhoni Touch". **
 
 
 
• **Rahul Dravid** is another **former Indian cricketer **who is known for his technique and sportsmanship.
 
 
• He has** not written** an autobiography as yet.
 
 
 
• **Yuvraj Singh** is a former Indian cricketer who is known for his** aggressive batting and left-arm spin bowling.**
 
 
• He has also written an autobiography called **"The Test of My Life".**
